scheme_name: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi‑Nomadic community.
Applicant must be enrolled in the 11th standard.
Applicant must be studying in a recognized institution.
Applicant must have studied continuously without any academic breaks.
benefits_summary: An incentive of ₹3,000 is provided to eligible girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time.
